articles.summary: CBS LA Cares highlights the Boys and Girls Clubs of Metro Los Angeles and their Challengers Clubhouse, a safe and supportive space where kids can learn, play, and grow through academics, sports, and creative programs. The feature emphasizes the club’s year-round impact on local youth and the importance of community support in helping these programs thrive.
articles.title: KCAL Cares spotlights resources offered by Boys and Girls Clubs of Metro Los Angeles

articles.summary: VenHub continues its rapid growth, featured on Yahoo Finance for the opening of our new corporate headquarters and production facility. This milestone marks a major step forward in scaling VenHub’s AI-powered Smart Stores and accelerating the future of autonomous retail.
articles.title: VenHub Expands Its Footprint With New Corporate Headquarters and Production Facility

articles.summary: Demand for contactless shopping continues to rise as consumers shift away from cash and toward digital payments. With fewer shoppers preferring cash and more planning to use digital wallets, expectations for seamless, touch-free experiences are becoming the norm. VenHub meets this shift by enabling safe, efficient shopping through a fully autonomous, contactless retail experience.
articles.title: Demand for Contactless Shopping Is Higher Than Ever
